title: Cornell Potential (QCD)
interpretation: Describes the effective potential between two quarks, combining the Coulomb-like behavior at short distances with the linear confinement term at large distances.
symmetry_origin: The non-abelian gauge symmetry of SU(3) and the flux-tube nature of the gluon field.
limits_and_boundary: As $r \to \infty$, the linear term $\kappa r$ necessitates an infinite energy to separate quarks, enforcing confinement.

title: Yukawa Potential (Residual Strong Force)
interpretation: Models the short-range attraction between nucleons as the exchange of massive mesons, providing the primary binding force for atomic nuclei.
symmetry_origin: The broken chiral symmetry and the resulting effective field theory of nucleon-meson interactions.
limits_and_boundary: Characterized by the range $R \sim 1/m$, explaining why the strong force is effectively zero beyond $10^{-15}$ meters.
